stem:
Naveen sprinkles a few drops of water on a hot pan. The drops disappear quickly. He wonders about water vapour, ordinary air, and boiling with big bubbles.

What has the liquid water become?

options.text: Liquid water again, because evaporation turns vapour into liquid.
Water vapour only if the water first boiled with big bubbles.

teacher.key_rationale: Evaporation turns liquid water into water vapour, even without boiling.
